title: A way for the owner to ask for a site rebuild after a failed or skipped build
why_needed: site_build_trigger gives each request five tries, then leaves `triggered_at >= requested_at` so nothing more is built until some new publish (20260930140000_audit2_fixes.sql:743-765); a NO_HOOK episode waits for the secret. The owner home only says «بناء الموقع: فاشل» (AdminHome.tsx:372-386), the admin has no rebuild control, and docs/operations.md:383-405 never tells the operator that after fixing the hook he must republish something (grep for redeploy/rebuild/retry instructions: none). An owner who fixes the hook and waits keeps a stale site, with the last publishes missing, and no screen saying so.
touches: an owner-only SQL function wrapping site_build_request() (granted to authenticated, role checked inside), a «أعد بناء الموقع» button on AdminHome's «بناء الموقع» line when the last run failed or was skipped, docs/operations.md 'Site rebuilds', a unit/integration test
